edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price set forth in Schedule 1 (the “Purchase Price”) for all of the issued and outstanding shares of the Company (the “Shares”), by wire transfer of immediately available funds at Closing, subject to any adjustments expressly provided in this Agreement.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur remotely by exchange of executed documents and signatures within thirty (30) days of signing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to Closing set forth in this Agreement, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to the Buyer have been prepared in good faith, are accurate in all material respects, and fairly present the financial condition and results of operations of the Company for the periods indicated, subject to normal year-end adjustments and the notes thereto.
edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations and procedures set forth in this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Buyer and its affiliates from and against losses arising out of any breach of the Seller’s representations, warranties, covenants, or obligations under this Agreement, including any undisclosed liabilities of the Company existing as of or relating to periods prior to Closing.
edits.name: Indemnity

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. We have made targeted revisions to address your threshold comments while preserving the core allocation of risk. In particular, we have narrowed the financial statement representation to Seller’s knowledge and to materials delivered to Buyer, and revised the indemnity to include survival, basket, cap, claims procedures, and exclusive remedy concepts, with customary carve-outs. We remain open to discussing the purchase price adjustment mechanics and closing deliverables in your markup.

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. To the Seller’s knowledge, the financial statements delivered to the Buyer prior to the date of this Agreement have been prepared in good faith from the books and records of the Company and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial condition and results of operations of the Company for the periods indicated, subject to normal year-end adjustments, the notes thereto, and the qualifications and limitations reflected in the materials actually delivered to the Buyer.
edits.name: Financial Statement Representation

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations and procedures set forth in this Agreement, from and after Closing the Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless the Buyer and its affiliates from and against losses finally incurred by them arising out of any breach of the Seller’s representations, warranties, covenants, or obligations under this Agreement. Claims for breaches of representations and warranties must be asserted within twelve (12) months after Closing, except that claims arising from fraud, willful misconduct, or breaches of fundamental representations may be asserted until the expiration of the applicable statute of limitations. The Seller shall have no liability for indemnifiable losses unless and until the aggregate amount of such losses exceeds an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Purchase Price, after which the Seller shall be liable only for amounts in excess of such threshold. The Seller’s aggregate liability for indemnifiable losses shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price, except in the case of fraud, willful misconduct, or breaches of fundamental representations. Except for claims for fraud, willful misconduct, equitable relief, or enforcement of express covenants requiring performance after Closing, the indemnification rights set forth in this Section 4 shall be the Buyer’s sole and exclusive remedy for monetary damages arising under or relating to this Agreement.
edits.name: Indemnity; Limitations
